messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated GPU OOMs in serving-runtime decode path (us-west-2). Observed sharp increase in CUDA OOMs affecting streaming responses; approx 12-15% request failures since 01:23 UTC. Paging oncall.

jordan (oncall): Ack — joining. Can someone confirm which routes and models? Any customer-facing impact yet?

telemetry-bot: Metrics snapshot: errors/req jumped from 0.2% -> 12.7% over last 6m. p95 latency stable, p99 has spikes. Top failing route: /v1/stream-decode (85% of failures). Affected nodes: decode-pool-{3,5,7}-usw2. Link: https://telemetry.internal/incident/1758881234

leo (runtime): Seeing repeated OOM stack traces in decode loop; KV cache growth is abnormal. Sample log: 
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Allocated 23.4GB, tried to allocate 1.2GB
  at decode_step /srv/runtime/kernels/decoder.cpp:412
```
Suspect unusually long generations. Gateway token-cap guard didn't fire — header mismatch hypothesis.

maria (sre): Oncall plan proposal: 1) throttle generation length at the gateway to 512 tokens 2) cordon & restart the worst node(s) 3) enable routing fallback to CPU variant for heavy sessions. Who can apply the route override?

jordan (oncall): I'll push a temporary override now. Applying to cut tail length and fallback to cpu variant: 
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/route-override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/stream-decode","max_generation":512,"fallback":{"model":"small-decode-cpu"}}'
```

devin (infra): Cordon/drain on decode-pool-5-usw2 in progress. Commands being run: 
```
kubectl cordon node/decode-pool-5-usw2
kubectl drain node/decode-pool-5-usw2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Restarting containers and checking dmesg for GPU driver issues.

sara (cs): Customer impact: AcmeApp reporting ~18% request drops, ticket INC-2124 open. They want ETA and whether their requests can be replayed safely. Drafting a customer note now.

leo (runtime): Root-cause note: a subset of clients are sending a nonstandard header `X-Span-MaxLen` with extremely large values (e.g. 200k) — older SDK bug. Runtime accepted that and merged it into generation cap, causing long tails and KV growth. Gateway hasn't been rejecting that header.

maria (sre): Good catch. Short-term: reject `X-Span-MaxLen` > 4000 at edge and normalize header names. Devin — can you add an nginx canary rule and flip if stable? I'll prepare a runtime hotfix to drop insane headers in 5m.

devin (infra): Staging nginx canary for 10% traffic with a sanity check: 
```
# canary rule (nginx)
server {
  if ($http_x_span_maxlen ~ "^[0-9]+$") {
    set $span_len $http_x_span_maxlen;
  }
  if ($span_len > 4000) {
    return 400;
  }
}
```
Pushing canary now. Will monitor canary metrics for 3m.

telemetry-bot: Canary metrics: requests with X-Span-MaxLen > 4000 dropped on canary. Error rate on canary decreased from 9% -> 1.2%. KV cache growth on canary nodes stabilizing. Waiting 3m for confidence.

jordan (oncall): Canary looks good. Rolling header filter to 100% and keeping route override in place. Gradually switching heavy sessions to `small-decode-cpu` fallback. Monitoring OOM counts.

sara (cs): Customer update sent: "We identified a client-side SDK sending excessively large generation requests which exhausted GPU memory. We applied temporary throttling and a header sanity filter; we're monitoring and will follow up with a permanent fix. Next update in 30m." :white_check_mark:

maria (sre): Follow-ups (tickets): 1) runtime hotfix: trim KV cache on long prefixes + drop insane headers 2) add alert for abnormal header value distribution 3) SDK advisory and regression test. I'll create the tickets and assign.

leo (runtime): Adding a safety-net: enforce a server-side hard cap at 8192 tokens for now, and tag telemetry for any request with header > 2000 so we can track regressions.

jordan (oncall): Pager status: mitigated -> monitoring. Keeping the route override and header filter live. Monitoring window 30m; escalate to SEV if OOMs reappear.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated; monitoring. Started: 1758881234. Mitigations applied: route override (max_generation=512 + cpu fallback), nginx header filter (X-Span-MaxLen sanity), cordon/restart of affected node(s). Next update due in 30m.
